answer: The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in summit, expire in atlas, and vertex lists each expiry. An adversary running 126 aliases therefore needs 51 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1392 identities would post 3835 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
